items.stem: A PivotTable summarises a source table. New rows are added to the source. What must happen for the PivotTable to reflect them?

options.text: Refresh the PivotTable (and ensure the source range or table includes the new rows)
options.rationale: Correct: PivotTables show a cached summary and update on refresh.

options.text: Nothing; PivotTables always show the latest source instantly
options.rationale: PivotTables use cached data and need a refresh.

options.text: Delete and recreate the PivotTable each time
options.rationale: A refresh is sufficient; recreation is unnecessary.

options.text: Convert the PivotTable to a chart
options.rationale: Charting does not refresh the underlying summary.

items.explanation: Correct: PivotTables show a cached summary and update on refresh.

items.stem: Which TWO chart choices are appropriate? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A line chart to show a monthly trend over two years
options.rationale: Correct: line charts suit continuous time series.

options.text: A clustered column chart to compare values across a few categories
options.rationale: Correct: column charts compare discrete categories well.

options.text: A pie chart to compare twelve months of revenue
options.rationale: Pie charts handle few parts of a whole, not a time series.

options.text: A 3-D exploding pie to show precise differences
options.rationale: 3-D distortion makes precise comparison harder, not easier.

items.explanation: Correct: line charts suit continuous time series.

items.stem: What is the main risk of applying many conditional-formatting colour rules to one table?

options.text: Visual noise that hides the exceptions you wanted to highlight
options.rationale: Correct: too much formatting defeats the purpose of exception reporting.

options.text: Excel disables the rules after a set number
options.rationale: Excel does not cap rules at a small number that would cause this.

options.text: The underlying values are permanently changed
options.rationale: Formatting does not change underlying values.
Conditional formatting does not affect refresh.
